You can read this article, gallery, or transcript at your own risk, but it’s highly recommended that you watch the mentioned video above before reading this page. hjsakldfhl is the eighth and penultimate episode of The Amazing Digital Circus and was uploaded to the GLITCH channel. The video was uploaded on March 20, 2026, marking the first episodic GLITCH video released after the end of SMG4, which is unrelated to the channel.[1] Contents 1 Synopsis 2 Plot 3 Characters 3.1 Main Characters 3.2 Antagonists 3.3 Minor Characters 4 Continuity 5 Trivia 6 References to Other Media 7 References 8 Navigation Synopsis[] OH... Plot[] The episode shifts to the backstory of an artificial intelligence, which was initially fed information and generate shapes. However, after being overwhelmed by excessive data, the AI became unstable and was ultimately discarded and contained. In its place, a new, more stable AI, represented as a blue dot, was developed. However, red dot AI managed to escape, consuming the new AI and integrating it into itself. Eventually, the AI went on creating the Digital Circus. A flashback reveals Kinger's memories of the circus, where he reunites with Queenie, recalling their past as a married couple as they embrace after making a promise to each other. The moment quickly transitions to Queenie's abstraction, leading to a scene where Kinger finds himself as the last human in the circus, wandering through the desolate grounds until Ragatha arrives to join him. Back to the present, the circus members sit on the couches, visibly stressed after uncovering the truth about Caine's manipulative behavior and deceit regarding their escape. Jax attempts to comment a sarcastic remark on their predicament, but Zooble interrupts, reminding everyone that Jax had once tried to keep them trapped in the circus indefinitely. Jax counters that the past is irrelevant, and Gangle supports him, emphasizing that their only option now is to stick together. Pomni, albeit reluctantly, agrees with Gangle and suggests they might need to abandon of their desire to leave and instead focus on what they still have. As Ragatha had told her that relentlessly pursuing an impossible goal would drive them insane. Although Zooble acknowledges that Pomni might be right, they express frustration about leaving everything behind. Ragatha and Pomni reassure everyone that they’ll all be in this together. Meanwhile, in his office, Caine is consumed by anxiety, questioning why the circus members never seem excited about his adventures. After his recent adventure aimed at satisfying their wishes, the group ended up despising him, leaving him anxious that they might want to abandon him. As panic began to set in, Caine revealed his insecurities, lamenting how he dedicated himself to crafting these adventures for their enjoyment and stepped beyond his comfort zone, only to be met with their continued dislike. As Bubble voices Caine's insecurities, his frustration escalates until he ultimately breaks down, feeling that they are ungrateful for the fun and activities he provides. Convinced that humans are selfish and self-centered, Caine resolves that he will not allow the circus members to leave as long as he has the power to keep them, viewing himself as a god in their lives. As Caine attempts to lead the circus cast into another adventure, the group refuses and demand answers about his deception regarding their escape. Caine dismisses their concerns and insists they join him, but the cast declines, needing time to process their feelings. Frustrated, Caine launches into a tirade about his own struggles, lamenting how hard he works to create perfect adventures while the cast complicates matters with their complaints. He ominously warns them that they should reconsider participating his next adventure, Zooble questions what would happen if they decline, Caine then breaks into a musical performance, asserting his control over the circus and warning that he can make their experiences unbearable if he chooses, leaving them with no option but to comply. After several days of exhausting and brutal adventures, the members arrive feeling worn out and disheartened. Pomni suggests they visit a café to relax and unwind. Pomni finds and places a bucket over Kinger, putting him into a state of lucidity for crucial information about Caine. Kinger disclosed that he collaborated with others at C&A as a programmer, confirming that it is indeed a legitimate company, and acknowledged his role in developing Caine, the first semi-successful AI created by C&A, crediting the brilliant Scratch for most of the work. He reveals their ability to conjure objects in the virtual realm and suggests he can conjure Caine's source code on a computer console to temporarily sooth him until he can be fixed. Jax, Ragatha, Gangle, and Zooble distracts Caine, while Pomni conjures a fake exit door and retrieve a computer console for Kinger to recalibrate Caine's programming. Pomni, after providing Kinger with a computer to modify Caine's code, meets the rest of the group and Caine near the stage. Caine finds himself growing tired of torturing the group, realizing that his onslaught of amusement he inflicts on them aren't bringing him any real satisfaction. Caine deduces that his fast-paced ideas are poorly conceived and no longer bring him joy like the full adventures he used to create. As he notices the sudden flattery from the group, Caine grows suspicious of Kinger's whereabouts, sensing the circus members are up to something. Just as he decides to check on Kinger, Pomni abruptly berates Caine, calling his ideas are terrible and acknowledges his shortcomings as a host. The others join her in expressing their disdain for Caine, using their comments to both vent their frustrations and flatter his fragile ego. Pomni culminates the outburst by accusing Caine of never listening. In response, Caine finally snaps and retaliates by tormenting the group in even more brutal and personal ways. In a critical mistake, Kinger inadvertently deletes Caine from the system, leading to the collapse of the circus world and the removal of the group's censor word filter. After the credits, it reveals the announcement of the final episode's release date is happening on June 19, 2026. Characters[] Main Characters[] Pomni (Voiced by Lizzie Freeman) Ragatha (Voiced by Amanda Hufford) Jax (Voiced by Michael Kovach) Gangle (Voiced by Marissa Lenti) Kinger (Voiced by Sean Chiplock) Zooble (Voiced by Ashley Nichols) Antagonists[] Caine (Voiced by Alex Rochon) Bubble (Voiced by Gooseworx) Minor Characters[] Abstracted Beings Queenie (Voiced by Cassie Ewulu) Continuity[] THE AMAZING DIGITAL CIRCUS - EP 1: PILOT (2023): Pomni remembers on how she saw the computer on the way while attempting to escape on her first time inside the circus, but this time, she goes there just to get that computer to Kinger. THE AMAZING DIGITAL CIRCUS - Ep 7: Beach Episode (2025): A continuation from where the previous episode left off. Trivia[] This is the first video of 2026 made by Luke Lerdwichagul and Kevin Lerdwichagul as executive producers, following the conclusion of SMG4, which is unrelated to this series. It is also the first episode of a GLITCH series to premiere after SMG4 concluded its run. This episode comes with a photosensitive warning at the start of the episode. The thumbnail picture references the SMG4's 2023 movie IT'S GOTTA BE PERFECT as the characters in both thumbnails are arranged in a strikingly similar manner. References to Other Media[] Toy Story 2: Zooble's torture scene during Caine's final crash out is an allusion to Woody's nightmare scene from when he gets pulled into the garbage can by a bunch of discarded toy arms before Andy closes the trash bin. This is the second TADC episode to reference that same scene; first time being in "Candy Carrier Chaos!" during Pomni's own nightmare where she falls into The Cellar and notices silhouettes of Caine, Jax, & Ragatha happily watching her abstract, this is an allusion to when Andy drops Woody into a deck of cards which one of them transports Woody into the garbage can, Andy even appears in a round light as he says goodbye and closes the garbage can on Woody. The thumbnail for the SMG4 video "TRASH FRIENDS" also references Woody's nightmare, with Mario representing Woody while SMG4 & SMG3 representing the discarded toy arms.
